title: Control (implementation)
description: The living state of a library control in this program: how far along, who owns it, which tools implement it, its coverage status. Owned by security.

implementation_pct.description: An honest number. The register prioritizes by this — lowest first.

implemented_by.description: Inventory system slugs that implement this control. The tool→control edge of the tree.

health.description: Drives branch residual: a mitigated risk resting on failing controls is quietly back to inherent.
